title: HB61 (2021 General): Concealed Carry Exemption During State of Emergency

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Utah) (gun-policy Stage 5, Utah); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Utah text (Introduced, ; official copy, https://le.utah.gov/~2021/bills/hbillint/HB0061.pdf (Open States text id 90098166))
provenance.note: Introduced version; bill text read is as filed. Subsection (2)(a) is existing law, shown for context (the clause (b) 'and' struck, joined to new (c)).

operative_text:
Section 1 (Utah Code 53-2a-214(2)(c)): the requirement to have a permit to carry a concealed firearm, in accordance with Sections 53-5-704 and 53-5-705, is suspended in the area over which the state of emergency applies for any individual who may lawfully own a firearm.
Section 1 (Utah Code 53-2a-214(2)(a)): During a declared state of emergency or local emergency under this part: (a) neither the governor nor an agency of a governmental entity or political subdivision of the state may impose restrictions, which were not in force before the declared state of emergency, on the lawful possession, transfer, sale, transport, storage, display, or use of a firearm or ammunition;
